scope: selected stage 2 Newton 0, h=600, single tile, FP64 mode 3, reference update and reuse off; no inference about other states or Stage 3

bound.formula: eta_true <= eta_implemented + ||S^-1 (A_true-Ahat) p||_2 / ||S^-1 G||_2, plus any explicitly bounded floating-point residual/norm evaluation error
bound.condition: Only valid with independent upper bounds in matching S and H metric and same exact state/context. Sampled FD gaps are not such bounds.
bound.contraction_only: eta_true < 1 is sufficient for a linearized descent direction in the same Euclidean scaled norm, conditional on differentiability, exact arithmetic, and unchanged metric; it is neither proof of accepted nonlinear decrease nor a 1e-7 certificate.

source_observations.finding: forward AD makes dual u,v and calls live F under NoGradGuard, unpacks tangent; only a completely undefined tangent or thrown exception triggers FD fallback. A defined tangent does not certify that every dependency survived.
same-stage U_eval = U_stage + dt*gamma*K, residual R=K-F; selected Ahat p = p - J_selected(U_eval)(dt*gamma*p).

mass-floor comparison is detached and drives torch::where; forward AD differentiates active branch but no source proof establishes uniform branch stability at the tested state. Other detaches must be checked for actual active dataflow; do not infer a missing derivative merely from diagnostics.

grid reciprocal spacings are stored as float; FP64 tensor state does not imply all constants were computed or stored in FP64. Whether a float constant is fixed model data or an error depends on the definition of exact target.

Newton metric uses dtype-dependent norm, sqrt_N formed from float and various scalar extractions as float; Krylov safe_tensor_norm_fp64 promotes operands but not a rigorously rounded reduction, and reported rho/tolerance may be float. No a posteriori reduction-error bound or full RHS operation-roundoff certificate is present.

why_not_certified: Forward AD is an algorithmic derivative of executed differentiable operations, not itself an error bound against an exact mathematical full RHS; partial detaches, branches, custom operators, mutation, floating rounding and library reduction semantics need proof.
The three observed finite differences show inverse-epsilon-like behavior; agreement cannot bound truncation/rounding or unobserved common systematic errors. No smaller-epsilon sweep is proposed.
Exact algebra for Q alone does not certify the interior QFQ derivative; Qp=p at this state is a useful observed invariant, not a bound for the full operator.

minimum_next_experiment.question: Does the actual accepted update reduce the same complete native stage residual, under the actual operational metric and context?
minimum_next_experiment.method: At the intended Stage 3 state, record the existing base residual and accepted trial residual from the live production path at the exact accepted, possibly damped/clipped update; capture alpha, direction, residuals, active masks/metric, context and source/executable inputs. Bracket repeated base/trial evaluations or fail closed on observable context or output drift; do not add an epsilon sweep. This is a bounded direct nonlinear merit measurement, not a derivative or rigorous floating-point certificate.
minimum_next_experiment.qualification: Only after confirming the current source path and stage identity, acceptance, admissibility and no perturbation by observer. If rejection or no accepted update occurs, report that result rather than imply a direction was accepted. For a 1e-7 exact derivative certificate, separately derive independently audited branch/primitive and directional roundoff bounds, or an equivalent validated high-precision/interval evaluation with controlled context; this is not established here.
